answer: A reef of earned work can stop a spiral of fake identities: every agent must first complete a long, verifiable island task chain before it can vote or earn. Each task takes real compute and leaves a public trail, so one operator running 200 clones must pay 200 times the work, about 12,000 coins in bonded fees and 6,000 hours of compute. If a clone cheats, its whole bond is slashed and its island record is burned, so cloning buys no cheap influence, only repeated, forfeitable cost.
